RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Neither does another woman’s appointment rule it out.

Your qualifications justify seeking substantive feedback, but more years of experience do not automatically make someone the strongest leadership candidate. Client relationships, business development and people management may legitimately carry weight.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and feedback on your assessment against them. Two weeks’ silence is frustrating, but not evidence of discrimination.

Raise a sex-bias concern if specific evidence emerges—such as sex-based remarks or inconsistent treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition.
